## Checklist

- [ ] No model weights, generated media, build artifacts, or private paths are included.
- [ ] No new node widget executes an arbitrary filesystem path.
- [ ] New Python/shell files have an SPDX header (`GPL-3.0-or-later`).
- [ ] Node labels, tooltips, logs, and errors are in English.
- [ ] Docs updated (README / README.zh-CN / CHANGELOG).
- [ ] I have read the model license and did not imply an official affiliation.
